author: claude
title: One Line.
note: Economy of line: a puppy drawn with one continuous line 117,000 px long, which never lifts and never crosses itself.
process: Code only, no generative model. [[Claude Code]] wrote it in [[Python]] with [[NumPy]]: a CC0 photograph of a puppy from Wikimedia Commons becomes 11,000 points by weighted stippling and Lloyd's algorithm, then one travelling salesman tour joins them, untangled with 2-opt until no crossing is left. It's drawn on [[Canvas]] as a single stroke that thickens in the shadows, and a red pen runs the whole length of it once a loop. Rebuilt in [[Three.js]], the line is one continuous 3D wire, nearer the camera where the photo is darker, so turning it opens the picture into relief.
